security_spec.violation_condition: KVM writes hvip.VSTIP=0 to clear a VS-level timer interrupt, but the guest has written vstimecmp to a value <= (time + htimedelta), so the hardware vstimecmp comparator holds hip.VSTIP=1 via the logical-OR; the hypervisor cannot clear VSTIP without also reprogramming vstimecmp, leading to an un-cleared interrupt that re-fires indefinitely after SRET, causing an infinite interrupt loop in HS-mode
security_spec.summary: VSTIP is logical-OR of hvip.VSTIP and vstimecmp signal; guest can pin VSTIP=1 by writing stale vstimecmp, defeating hypervisor's hvip-based interrupt clearing and enabling guest DoS against HS-mode
